name: ariane6 booster
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), ariane6: booster. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Shown as A64. Core and upper-stage split estimated.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: Arianespace Ariane 6 User's Manual (2021): 5.4 m core, P120C boosters 3.4 m x 13.5 m, long fairing 20 m, A64 62 m | Wikipedia 'Ariane 6': Vulcain 2.1, Vinci

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail); copper: copper-alloy chamber and bell (Raptor, Merlin), oxidised; soot: a nozzle's sooty inside
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
